shorts.title: I Volunteered for a Vampire Bat 🦇 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
Vampire bats don't suck blood. A vampire bat can die after about 70 hours without a meal, which is why roostmates share.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.comment:
Would you let one bite you for science? 👇

shorts.title: I Asked a Black Widow Out 🕷️ (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
Black widows usually don't eat their mates. In a few Southern Hemisphere widow species, eating the male is the norm. Not this one.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths
